run_a1_simulation: run the pybullet GUI simulation that loads and animates the Unitree A1 quadruped robot
load_a1_urdf: load the A1 quadruped robot URDF model into a pybullet simulation environment
enumerate_motor_joints: enumerate and identify all 12 motor joint IDs by name from the A1 robot URDF
control_joint_positions: set position control on each A1 robot joint using initial abduction, hip, and knee angles
step_simulation_loop: run the pybullet physics simulation loop stepping at 240 Hz while the connection is active
